commitment: We will continue to add verified studies, benchmark-level harness changes and revised syntheses as new evidence becomes available. Each evidence release will be dated and traceable; the paper’s frozen snapshot will remain identifiable.
cadence: AI-assisted literature searches are scheduled daily at 09:00 Pacific time. Verified additions and corrections update the bibliography, collection charts, repository overview and website after validation. Literature, evidence and presentation retain separate dates; a scheduled search does not guarantee new studies or complete coverage.

steps.title: Find & screen
steps.text: Search daily for new studies and revisions, with overlapping date windows; verify primary sources and distinguish reusable harness changes from model training and background work.

steps.title: Trace the change
steps.text: Record the setting, seed, actual edit, result and source location. Keep missing artifacts, regressions and transfer conditions visible.

steps.title: Revise & release
steps.text: Rebuild the collection and website, validate changes, and push a traceable commit. Revise benchmark comparisons only when new evidence supports them; preserve the paper snapshot.

releases.title: Literature backfill: memory skills, retrieval evolution and harness-training boundaries
changes: Newly collected five previously released works: MemSkill, ERSkill, SESA, Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling, and Self-Evolving Agent Harness. These are newly collected papers, not five papers published today.

Separated reusable memory-construction and retrieval programs from trained controllers and solver policies; categorized the self-evolving harness definition paper as conceptual background rather than an empirical benchmark discovery.

Checked current arXiv versions; ERSkill author Guangxu Zhu follows the primary full text rather than its misspelled abstract metadata. MemSkill NeurIPS 2026 acceptance remains explicitly author-reported.
Living collection now contains 269 papers and 11 resources; targeted overlapping search through October 20. Frozen 95-record evidence, dataset v0.1.0, and submission manuscript remain unchanged.

releases.title: Monday literature backfill: reusable memories, tool documentation and failure-aware evaluation
changes: Newly collected six existing studies after overlapping discovery and Monday survey/core-paper reference follow-up: MUSE, ContDa, AgentFactory executable subagents, EvoHarness-RL, Does Failure Feedback Direct Agent Self-Modification?, and Two Perspectives on Recursive Self-Improvement. These are newly collected works, not six papers published today.

Merged MUSE's differently titled 2025 preprint and final ACL Findings paper, and AgentFactory's preprint and ACL demonstration version, as one study each. EvoHarness-RL uses its current v2 title and authors and is categorized as policy training plus external-experience evolution; its workshop acceptance is author-reported.
Kept ContDa's release at verified proceedings-month precision because an earlier posting was not verified. Mem2Evolve remains pending while its earlier OpenReview posting date is unresolved.

Living collection now contains 264 papers and 11 resources; search horizon advances to October 19. The frozen 95-record evidence set, dataset v0.1.0 annotations and submission manuscript remain unchanged.

releases.title: Evidence dataset v0.1.0 and supplementary literature screening
changes: Published a versioned additive dataset view of the unchanged 95 category-source records, with JSON, JSONL, CSV, schema, checksums, citation and a dataset card. Dataset units are not independent interventions.

Added a selected structured-annotation pilot: four records, six scoped signals, with explicit outcome, retention, attribution and source links. The other 91 records remain unreviewed for these labels; no failure-rate or complete-annotation claim is made.
Added homepage dataset downloads and outcome comparisons, distinguishing regressions, no-gain proposals, trade-offs and usage observations. No dataset-specific reuse license is granted.

Newly collected five previously omitted papers: HarnessSR, HarnessTTT, HarnessNet, Harness^2 and WorkflowOps, first submitted October 6-12. Total living collection: 258 papers and 11 resources; ten papers newly collected across today’s two updates.
Bibliography additions do not extend the frozen evidence cutoff, its 95 records, or the submission manuscript. Unresolved candidates remain in local screening notes.

releases.title: Workflow reuse and skill-generalization literature update
changes: Newly collected five existing studies after primary-source screening: CB-Orchestrator, LAWA, DAGO, InFlowOp and Generalizable Skill Optimization. These are newly collected older works, not five newly published papers.
Separated reusable workflow search and skill-generalization evidence from InFlowOp, which is categorized as adjacent task-time workflow repair rather than a retained cross-task harness discovery.

Deduplicated workshop and arXiv versions of CB-Orchestrator and DAGO as one study each. Their exact earliest public posting dates remain unresolved and are recorded with year precision instead of treating October arXiv dates as first publication.

Completed overlapping targeted discovery for October 10-18 and retained unresolved candidates locally. Refreshed collection statistics and downloads; the 95-record evidence snapshot, manuscript cutoff and benchmark findings are unchanged.

releases.title: First daily literature update
changes: Added 13 primary-source-checked preprints to the living collection: 11 harness, skill, memory or improver methods, plus two separately categorized infrastructure and reliability studies.

Recorded first-submission dates and v1 method locators. Skill-V and EvoAlloc were first submitted on October 8 and are newly collected older papers, not new publications today. Other additions were first submitted October 10–15.

Extended the completed search horizon from October 10 to October 17, with overlapping discovery queries and unresolved candidates retained for later screening. Updated collection statistics and downloads; the 95-record frozen evidence snapshot and its cutoff are unchanged.

policy.title: Trace every substantive change
policy.text: New evidence identifies a task setting, starting harness, reusable edit, observed result and primary-source location. Reporting gaps remain explicit.

policy.title: Keep versions and units distinct
policy.text: A revised paper updates its source record. One artifact evaluated on several settings is not counted as several independent discoveries.

policy.title: Publish corrections with context
policy.text: A correction records what changed and why. Conflicting code, unclear retention and negative results remain attached to the original setting.

policy.title: Preserve the paper snapshot
policy.text: The frozen survey cutoff stays identifiable. A bibliography import or website redesign does not silently extend the evidence collection.

policy.title: Verify publication and recover failures
policy.text: Updates are complete only after validation, a matching remote commit and a successful website deployment. Failed searches or publications retain separate status and are retried; neither a schedule nor an authentication test counts as a completed update.
